aiDescriptions.n: No feature that drafts comments or annotations with an LLM found. Select AI only reads comments and annotations you write.

bulkMetadata.n: COMMENT ON and ANNOTATIONS DDL, by SQL script. Annotations are 26ai (Oracle blog says backported to 19.28). No bulk API found.

autoClassify.n: Oracle Data Safe, a separate OCI service, discovers and classifies sensitive data with 150+ predefined types. It does not feed Select AI.

sampleValues.n: No value sampling found. Select AI matches literals case-insensitively by default; profile attribute case_sensitive_values turns that off.

queryHistory.n: No mining of query history for joins, metrics or examples found in the pages I could check.

lineage.n: No native column-level lineage confirmed. OCI Data Catalog has a lineage page, but its column-level scope was not checked.

evals.n: Select AI feedback: positive feedback stores prompt and SQL in a per-profile vector index used as hints. 26ai only. No benchmark runner found.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write business meaning in table and column COMMENT ON text and in ANNOTATIONS, then set the Select AI profile attributes comments and annotations to true. Add annotations with ALTER TABLE ... ANNOTATIONS (ADD name 'value'). Record good answers with Select AI FEEDBACK so they become hints.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write column and table comments with the COMMENT statement, one per object, in a script. The Teradata MCP server (MIT, community project) can also load domain tools, prompts and cubes from YAML for an agent. Review all text by hand, because no generator was found.

bulkSnippet.code:
-- Placing form: COMMENT [ON] object-kind name IS 'text'
COMMENT ON COLUMN sales.orders.status IS 'open, shipped, or cancelled. Exclude cancelled from revenue.';

notes.text: WebSearch budget ran out mid-task and WebFetch could not reach vendor hosts (docs.oracle.com, postgresql.org, clickhouse.com, duckdb.org, teradata). I used search summaries and GitHub pages only. A level 0 means not found in what I could check, not proven absent.

URLs for clickhouse.com, duckdb.org and postgresql.org docs come from research/postgres-clickhouse-duckdb.json. I did not re-fetch them. The Postgres COMMENT syntax was verified from the postgres/postgres GitHub source. The ClickHouse snippet is the documented COMMENT COLUMN form, unverified in this session.

Search summaries disagree on version. One Oracle blog says annotations were introduced in 26ai and backported to 19.28; an Autonomous release note says 23ai. The column-level annotation DDL form was not verified, so the snippet shows table level only.

notes.topic: Oracle Select AI feedback as evals
notes.text: Docs say feedback works only on 26ai with an NL2SQL profile, and creates a vector index named <profile>_FEEDBACK_VECINDEX. Negative feedback is refined by an LLM and stored as hints. I rated it 3 because no Preview label was seen, but the label was not checked on the page itself.

Almost nothing Teradata-specific on AI metadata was confirmed. The Teradata MCP server on GitHub is described as community development under the MIT license and offers YAML semantic layer tools. Enterprise Vector Store and VantageCloud AI features were not verified.
